list.title: New Version Guide
list.header: [Sanctuary of Ink] New Version Guide Page Release Details

data.html:
[Sanctuary of Ink] New Version Guide Page is now live. Check out all the new version content in one place. Browse to claim [Oroberyl]×1,000, [T-Creds]×10,000, [Elementary Cognitive Carrier]×8, and [Arms INSP Set]×4.


▼// Page Link

Endministrators can open the New Version Guide page using the link below.

>>Click to Go


▼// Webpage Launch Time

· The New Version Guide page will be permanently available to browse from Oct. 6, 2026 at 20:00 (UTC+8) and its content will be replaced with each game version.

· Each New Version Guide page will be available from the airing of the Version Preview for the corresponding version until before the Version Preview for the next version ends.


▼// Reward Requirements

· Log in to your game account on the New Version Guide page and finish character creation in Arknights: Endfield.


▼// Reward Claiming Instructions

· Reward Claiming Period: After the [Sanctuary of Ink] New Version Guide page is released, and until before the [Sanctuary of Ink] version update & maintenance, the rewards can be claimed on that page.

· During the reward claiming period, a "claim rewards" button will be displayed on the New Version Guide page. Once the period ends, the button will no longer be displayed, and the rewards for that version can no longer be claimed.

· Once rewards are successfully claimed on the New Version Guide page, they will be delivered to the in-game mail of the character associated with the currently logged-in account.

· Each game account can claim the rewards from a given New Version Guide only once.


※ Please check the page for more details.

Dear Endministrator,
During the [Protocol Pass: Ink Scroll] period, you can access various support projects provided by the Arsenal Engineers through the [Protocol Pass] system. Upon the launch of each Protocol Pass season, the [Basic Supply] tier will be unlocked by default. By increasing your Pass Level, you can obtain rewards such as [Basic HH Permits], [Oroberyls], [Exchange Crates-o-Surprise], and [Progression Materials].
The [Originium Supply] tier can be unlocked with [Origeometry] and grants [Basic HH Permit], [Sticker: Minimalist Ink Spirit], [Filter: Wuling Impression], and additional rewards such as [Weapon Supply: Ink Scroll], [Origeometry], and [Emergency Sanity Booster].
Purchase the [Protocol Customized] tier to get [Profile: Aspiration for the Clouds], [Portrait Frame: Ink Mountains], [Portrait: Doodled Lung], plus bonus rewards such as [Weapon Supply: Ink Scroll], [Arsenal Ticket], and [Protocolized Weapon Pattern].

▼// Availability
Throughout the [Sanctuary of Ink] version

▼// Participation Criteria
Complete the main mission [Chapter I Process I: Break the Siege]

▼// Protocol Pass Details
· Activating the [Protocol Pass] unlocks the [Basic Supply] tier by default. You can purchase the [Protocol Customized] tier or spend [Origeometry] to unlock the [Originium Supply] tier for additional rewards and Pass EXP Earning Bonus.
· For each pass season, the [Originium Supply] and [Protocol Customized] tiers each contain a [Weapon Supply], which allows you to choose and acquire one of the season's featured 6★ weapons. [Protocolized Weapon Patterns] can raise the potential of any weapon provided by Protocol Pass [Weapon Supplies].
· Complete various Pass Missions (some missions will become available after meeting certain criteria or over time), or take part in [Operational Manual - Daily Tasks] and claim the max daily Activity Points rewards to earn Pass EXP. Level up the Pass to unlock a variety of [Protocol Pass] rewards.
· After unlocking [Originium Supply] or [Protocol Customized], you can continue earning Pass EXP even after maxing out the [Protocol Pass] level. Any Pass EXP beyond the cap will accumulate to grant [Cycling Crates-o-Surprise] as rewards. The crate opens automatically upon receipt and grants a random [Oroberyl] reward, a random [Progression Material] reward and a random [Sanity Usage Permit] reward.
· Unlocking the [Originium Supply] / [Protocol Customized] tier of the seasonal Protocol Pass grants +3% / +3% EXP bonus respectively. Unlocking both tiers grants a +6% EXP bonus.
· For excessive purchases of [Protocol Customized] due to special circumstances, rewards from the [Protocol Customized] tier will not stack. Instead, an amount of [Origeometry] based on the value of the purchase will be returned to you.
· When the [Protocol Pass] season ends, any unclaimed pass level rewards shall be sent to your Mail.

※ Asia Server Time Zone: UTC+8
※ Americas / Europe Server Time Zone: UTC-5
※ For detailed rules, visit [Protocol Pass] in-game and check [Protocol Pass Details].

Dear Endministrator,
During the [Sanctuary of Ink] version, the [Acquisition Center] will offer a variety of bundles.


▼// Limited Bundles
■ Wondrous View Collection Pack
· Availability: Throughout the [Sanctuary of Ink] version
· Bundle Contents: [Chartered HH Permit]×1, [Sticker: Solemn Gaze]×1, [Sticker: Aha...]×1, [Sticker: Looking Around]×1
· Special Note: Only 1 purchase allowed

■ Protocol Flow Bundle
· Availability: Throughout the [Sanctuary of Ink] version
· Bundle Contents: [Chartered HH Permit]×10, [Arsenal Ticket]×2000, [Mark of Perseverance]×10
· Special Note: Only 1 purchase allowed in current version

■ Omnipresence HH Bundle
· Availability: After [Sanctuary of Ink] version update – Nov. 5, 2026 at 11:59 (server time)
· Bundle Contents: [Spirit's Restoration HH Permit]×10, [T-Creds]×80000
· Special Note: Only 1 purchase allowed

■ Star River HH Bundle
· Availability: Nov. 5, 2026 at 12:00 (server time) – Before version update and maintenance
· Bundle Contents: [The Stars Are With Me HH Permit]×10, [T-Creds]×80000
· Special Note: Only 1 purchase allowed

■ Value Arsenal Ticket Pack
· Bundle Contents: [Arsenal Ticket]×2000
· Special Note: Only 1 purchase allowed. Purchase limit resets when [Chartered Headhunting] is updated.

※ Asia Server Time Zone: UTC+8
※ Americas / Europe Server Time Zone: UTC-5
※ Some bundles may include limited-time items. You can check the details of limited-time items in [Purchase - Item Contents]. If limited-time items in a bundle expire after purchase, they cannot be reissued. Thank you for your understanding and support.
※ For more bundles and their details, visit the in-game [Acquisition Center - Bundles].

Dear Endministrator,

During [Rejuvenation] Chartered Headhunting, the 6★ operator [Si] is Rate-UP!

The [Spirit's Restoration] limited-time sign-in event will open simultaneously. Accumulate sign-ins to earn rewards such as [Spirit's Restoration HH Permit]×5. You can also exchange for [Spirit's Restoration HH Permit] at a discount in [AIC Quota Exchange]. The [Combat Drills] operator trial event will also be available during this period.


▼// [Rejuvenation] Chartered Headhunting

· Availability: After [Sanctuary of Ink] version update – Nov. 5, 2026 at 11:59 (server time)

· Participation Criteria: Complete the main mission [Chapter I Process I: Break the Siege]

· [Rejuvenation] Chartered Headhunting features the Rate-UP 6★ operator [Si].

· 6★ operators that may appear in [Rejuvenation] Chartered Headhunting include: Si / Typhoeus / Liino / Ember / Lifeng / Ardelia / Last Rite / Pogranichnik.

· In [Rejuvenation] Chartered Headhunting, you can use [Spirit's Restoration HH Permit], [Chartered HH Permit], or [Oroberyls] to perform headhunting.

※ The Rate-UP 6★ operator featured in a [Chartered Headhunting] banner will be, after 3 [Chartered Headhunting] banners, removed from the list of operators that may appear in [Chartered Headhunting]. This Rate-UP 6★ operator will also not be added to [Basic Headhunting].


▼// [Chartered Headhunting] Rewards

In [Rejuvenation] Chartered Headhunting, perform a certain number of headhunting attempts to earn corresponding rewards.


■ Urgent Recruitment

· After performing 30 headhunting attempts, you will receive 10 bonus Urgent Recruitment attempts (which count as 1 free 10× headhunting attempt). This is only valid during this [Chartered Headhunting] banner, and does not carry over to other headhunting banners.

· The rates for obtaining operators through Urgent Recruitment are the same as the base drop rates of this [Chartered Headhunting] banner, and the free 10× headhunting attempt from Urgent Recruitment guarantees a 5★ or better operator.

· This free 10× headhunting attempt given by Urgent Recruitment does not count toward the guarantee for this or other [Chartered Headhunting] banners. It also will not be added to the total headhunting attempts required for [Chartered Headhunting] rewards.

■ Headhunting Dossier

· After performing 60 headhunting attempts, you will receive a bonus [Headhunting Dossier]×1.

· Once the requirements are met, the [Headhunting Dossier] will be automatically sent to your Valuables Stash. Once the next [Chartered Headhunting] banner begins, this [Headhunting Dossier] will be automatically converted to special HH Permit×10 of the specified [Chartered Headhunting] banner. However, the HH Permits will also expire once that banner ends.

■ Token Tribute

· In each [Chartered Headhunting] banner, every 240 headhunting attempts give a bonus [Token of the Rate-UP 6★ operator featured in the said banner]×1.


▼// Arsenal Ticket Details

Every headhunting attempt for operators also gives [Arsenal Tickets].

· Acquiring a 6★ operator gives [Arsenal Ticket]×2000.

· Acquiring a 5★ operator gives [Arsenal Ticket]×200.

· Acquiring a 4★ operator gives [Arsenal Ticket]×20.

※ [Arsenal Tickets] can be spent at the [Acquisition Center - Arsenal Exchange].


During [Rejuvenation] Chartered Headhunting, the following content will also be available:

▼// [Spirit's Restoration] Limited-Time Sign-In Event

Sign in for a total of 7 days to earn rewards such as [Spirit's Restoration HH Permit]×5.


▼// [Combat Drills] Operator Trial Event

[Combat Drills] will become available for trying out the 6★ operator [Si]. Complete the specified stage with the preset team that includes the trial operator to claim [Oroberyl]×100, [Arsenal Defense Crate], [Mark of Perseverance], and other rewards. The [Arsenal Defense Crate] contains a Fully Artificed Level 60 Gear Set that is a good fit for the current trial operator.


▼// [AIC Quota Exchange] Special Note

The [Quota Exchange] will offer limited-time special deals. You can spend AIC Quota to purchase items such as [Spirit's Restoration HH Permit]×5.


※ Asia Server Time Zone: UTC+8

※ Americas / Europe Server Time Zone: UTC -5

※ For more headhunting details, check the in-game [Headhunting] screen.

※ For more event details, check the in-game [Event Center].

※ For details on [AIC Quota Exchange], check the in-game [Acquisition Center].

▼// Availability
Opens Oct. 5, 2026 at 12:00 (server time); series remains permanently available thereafter.

▼// Event Rewards
During [Umbral Monument - Marked by Dark Shadows], complete all challenge stages to earn rewards that include: [Mark of Perseverance], [Advanced Cognitive Carrier], [Arms INSP Set], and [Protohedron].

▼// Participation Criteria
· Complete the main mission [Chapter I Process II: Paving the Way]
· Authority Level ≥ 30

▼// Gameplay Details
· The [Umbral Monument] Challenge Gameplay introduces the [Marked by Dark Shadows] series, featuring 4 stages.
· Each stage is divided into Normal and Agony modes. Complete the Normal mode to unlock the significantly more challenging Agony mode.
· Complete every stage of the current series in Normal mode to earn an engraved medal for the series. Complete every stage of the current series in Agony mode to trim the engraved medal.

▼// [Monumental Etching: Shadow Marked] Limited-Time Challenge Event
· Event Time: Oct. 5, 2026 at 12:00 – Oct. 19, 2026 at 04:00 (server time)
· Event Details: Upon the release of the [Umbral Monument - Marked by Dark Shadows] series, the limited-time event [Monumental Etching: Shadow Marked] will begin. During the event, complete various [Umbral Monument] challenges to claim [Monumental Etching: Shadow Marked] event rewards.

※ Asia Server Time Zone: UTC+8
※ Americas / Europe Server Time Zone: UTC-5
※ For more event details, check the in-game [Event Center].

Dear Endministrator,

While [Seal of Jade Issue] is available, the chance of getting the 6★ weapon [Jade Vessel (Greatsword)] is increased!


▼// [Seal of Jade Issue]

· Availability: Opens after [Sanctuary of Ink] version update; ends after 3 [Chartered Headhunting] banners (starting from [Rejuvenation])

· Participation Criteria: Complete the main mission [Chapter I Process I: Break the Siege]

· [Seal of Jade Issue] features the Rate-UP 6★ weapon [Jade Vessel (Greatsword)].

· 6★ weapons that may appear in [Seal of Jade Issue] include: Jade Vessel (Greatsword) / Former Finery (Greatsword) / Wedge (Handcannon) / JET (Polearm) / Chivalric Virtues (Arts Unit) / Sundered Prince (Greatsword) / Eminent Repute (Sword).


▼// [Arsenal Issue] Rewards

In every [Arsenal Issue], performing a set number of issues gives the banner's specific [Arms Offering Crate] (Arms OC) or [Rate-UP 6★ Weapon] in alternating order. The total number of issues for these Arsenal Issue rewards will be reset once the banner ends, and will not carry over to other [Arsenal Issue] banners.


▼// [Arsenal Issue] Details

· In [Arsenal Issue], you can spend [Arsenal Tickets] to apply for an issue.

· Each issue gives 10 random weapons from the list of available weapons, including at least one 5★ or better weapon.


▼// [Arsenal Exchange] Details

In [Arsenal Exchange], the [Arsenal Ticket] can also be used to directly purchase weapons. Some purchasable weapons may be updated every now and then. Check the information displayed on the [Acquisition Center - Arsenal Exchange] screen for what is actually available.


※ For more details and reward rules, visit the in-game [Acquisition Center - Arsenal Exchange].

Dear Endministrator,

Thank you all for your continued support! Arknights: Endfield has officially been added to over 300,000 Steam wishlists! At the same time, we are pleased to officially announce that Arknights: Endfield will be launching on Steam on Oct. 15!

All Endministrators can now unlock the final reward — the special commemorative portrait frame — as well as all milestone rewards from the previous phases.

▼// Redemption Code

ENDFIELDSTEAM

▼// Reward Details

· T-Creds ×8,000

· Elementary Cognitive Carrier×2

· Arms INSP Set×2

· Special Commemorative Portrait Frame×1

▼// Redemption Time

Asia Server: Oct. 6, 2026 at 19:30 – Nov. 25, 2026 at 23:59 (UTC+8)

Americas / Europe Server: Oct. 6, 2026 at 06:30 – Nov. 25, 2026 at 10:59 (UTC-5)

Haven't added Arknights: Endfield to your Steam Wishlist yet? Click the link and add it now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4732690/

Don't forget to join our Discord and connect with fellow Endministrators! https://discord.gg/akendfield

▼// Event Time

After [Sanctuary of Ink] version update – Before version update and maintenance

· Event Phase 1 Start Time: After [Sanctuary of Ink] version update

· Event Phase 2 Start Time: Oct. 22, 2026 at 04:00 (server time)


▼// Event Rewards

During the event, manage Yuanyuan Manor Inn to earn rewards including [Oroberyl]×1000, [Advanced Progression Selection Crate II], [Advanced Cognitive Carrier], [Mark of Perseverance], [T-Creds], and [Protoset].


▼// Participation Requirements

· In the side mission [A Painting Open for Business], complete the objective [Run the Inn].

· Complete the main mission [Chapter II Process VIII: Paint with Fresh Ink] to unlock the mission [A Painting Open for Business].


▼// Event Details

· During the event, visit the area [Si's Painting] in the region of Wuling, manage Yuanyuan Manor Inn, complete the corresponding Session Tasks, and increase your Inn Milestones to earn generous rewards.

· After Phase 2 begins, raise the Inn Rating to Lv. 4 to unlock the Theme [Gourmand Feast]. This Theme allows you to complete newly added Session Tasks.

· After the [Yuanyuan's Blazing Stoves] Fun & Games Event ends, you will no longer be able to complete Session Tasks or claim the corresponding rewards. However, you can still play Yuanyuan Manor Inn and claim Inn Milestone Phase rewards.


※ Asia Server Time Zone: UTC+8

※ Americas / Europe Server Time Zone: UTC -5

※ For more event details, check the in-game [Event Center].

Thank you for your continued interest and support for Arknights: Endfield. To maintain a healthy and fair gaming environment and protect the legitimate rights and interests of all players, we would like to remind everyone of the following:

1. The use of cheats, third-party tools, unauthorized top-ups, or any other improper methods that disrupt the game's integrity or violate the Game Terms of Service is strictly prohibited. Based on backend monitoring and player reports, if such violations are confirmed, we will take appropriate action depending on the severity of the offense, including but not limited to the removal of illicit gains, temporary suspension, or permanent account bans.

2. To protect the legitimate rights and interests of all players, please do not transfer, share, or trade your game account. Any consequences resulting from such actions, including account theft or loss of in-game assets, shall be borne by the player.

3. To ensure a complete gameplay experience, players are strictly prohibited from unpacking, modifying, or tampering with the game installation files, as well as distributing related extracted materials.

Finally, creating a positive and fair gaming environment requires the collective efforts of all players. We kindly ask everyone to help maintain a fair and orderly gaming environment. If you come across any violations, please feel free to report them through our official customer service center.

list.title: Feature Usage Policy
list.header: Automated Industry Complex & Blueprint Usage Policy

data.html:
To ensure a friendly gaming environment, please follow our Terms of Service when using features related to the Automated Industry Complex. Please do not post or engage in content that involves:

1. Discrimination based on region, race, sexual orientation, religion, politics, etc.

2. Defamation, offense, or infringement of others' rights

3. Obscenity, violence, gambling, or hate

4. Anything prohibited or deemed inappropriate by the Terms of Service

If you engage in any of the above violations, penalties may be applied, including removal of items placed in the Automated Industry Complex, restrictions on AIC Factory features, and account suspension. To report violations, use the [Report] button or contact customer support.

If you use the [Share Blueprint] feature, you will get a [Blueprint Code] that lets other Endministrators view and use your [Blueprint]. Before getting started, please note: by sharing your [Blueprint Code], you're allowing anyone to view, copy, or use your design. Please consider carefully before sharing.

Terms of Service

▼// Time Available

Once the official release goes live

▼// Exploration Rewards

While [Etchspace Salvage] is available, reach the specified operation metrics to earn rewards that include: [Oroberyls], [Basic HH Permit], and [progression materials].

▼// Participation Requirements

Complete the main mission [Chapter I Process III: Mystery in the Building]

▼// Gameplay Details

· [Etchspace Salvage] is a permanent activity where you go aboard Dijiang to enter and explore the [Valley's Aberrants]. While exploring, accept and complete various commissions to unlock Exploration Support Tech that improves your ability to explore the Valley's Aberrants, and earn rewards including [Oroberyls].

· Earn operation metrics by completing specific commissions or bringing out [precipitation nodules] from the Valley's Aberrants. Earn enough operation metrics to acquire rewards.

※ For more details, open the in-game [Etchspace Salvage] screen and click [Gameplay Details].

[Daily Sign-in]

The Daily Sign-in Tool allows you to sign in daily to obtain rewards like Oroberyl, Advanced Combat Records, Arms INSP Sets, Protoprisms, and Talosian Credit Notes. Bind your characters and, upon completing your first three daily sign-ins, you'll receive 300 Oroberyl!

Go

[WIKI]

The WIKI is a tool with content created and maintained through a group of Endministrators’ effort. It's a convenient and detailed resource for checking in-game info.

Here, you can view basic Operator and item information, Weapon Files, and much more.

Go

[Map Tools]

The map tools provides a comprehensive account of in-game resources and facilities, allowing players to search, filter, and locate areas of interest.

It offers more than just a view of storage crates, collectibles, enemies and similar key content: once logged in, you can also see your own ziplines, Electric Pylons, and other structures you've built. This all makes your Talos-II exploration that much easier.

Go

[Protocol Terminal]

The Protocol Terminal grants players a convenient way to search game data such as that concerning operators and region development. You'll have Sanity stats, Daily Task progress, and much more real-time data at your fingertips.

Go

[Team Picks and Build Guide]

Game Tools grant Endministrators a wealth of info to reference, spanning team setups, skill suggestions, and combat strategies. Browse the setups shared by other passionate Arknights: Endfield players, and give your favorites a like.

We hope this will aid Endministrators in quickly forming their perfect teams, ready for any challenge that awaits!

Load up Arknights: Endfield, open [Protocol Synchronizer], and press the Game Tools button.
